name: Boies Schiller

summary.text: Boies, Schiller & Flexner is a U.S. litigation firm founded by David Boies. It served as outside counsel to Theranos from 2011, was reported to have been paid in Theranos stock for patent work, and withdrew from representing the company in 2016 amid a disagreement, according to Wall Street Journal reporting by John Carreyrou as summarised by secondary sources.
